description:
## 0.3.1 (2026-11-11)

### 🐞 Bug Fixes

* **Cloudflare WARP while open:** opening YouTube sometimes left the home feed grey (loading placeholders) until the app was restarted. Connections the app opened in the first moment, before the VPN was up, were silently dropped inside the tunnel, so the app waited for its own timeout. They are now refused at once and the app retries through WARP.

Built for YouTube 21.16.256 with Morphe Patches 1.45.0 and Spoof video streams = visionOS. Checked on the phone with interleaved cold starts: grey feed 3/13 before, 0/8 after.
